title: DST task force: CII quantum-safe by 2029, vendor CBOMs from FY 2027-28
body: The DST task force report 'Implementation of Quantum Safe Ecosystem in India' sets CII milestones: foundations and a cryptographic inventory by 31 Dec 2027, high-priority systems migrated by 31 Dec 2028, full PQC adoption by 31 Dec 2029 (other enterprises: 2028, 2030, 2033). Organisations should request CBOMs from vendors from FY 2026-27 and mandate them through procurement from FY 2027-28.

title: RBI constitutes the Q-SAFE expert committee
body: The Reserve Bank of India constituted an eight-member expert committee for a Quantum Secure and Adaptive Financial Ecosystem (Q-SAFE). Its remit includes assessing the financial sector's cryptographic inventory through a CBOM, crypto agility and vendor readiness, and recommending a roadmap within six months of its first meeting.

title: US EO 14412: federal PQC encryption by 2030, authentication by 2035
body: Executive Order 14412, 'Securing the Nation Against Advanced Cryptographic Attacks', sets 31 Dec 2030 for federal agencies' most sensitive systems to use post-quantum encryption and 31 Dec 2035 for post-quantum authentication, with NIST post-quantum FIPS requirements for federal contractors.

title: EU roadmap: critical infrastructure on PQC by end of 2030
body: The EU coordinated implementation roadmap asks Member States to start the transition, including cryptographic inventories, by the end of 2026, and to move high-risk and critical-infrastructure use cases to post-quantum cryptography by the end of 2030.
source: European Commission and NIS Cooperation Group

title: NIST IR 8547 (draft): RSA and ECC deprecated after 2030, disallowed after 2035
body: The initial public draft of NIST IR 8547 proposes deprecating 112-bit RSA and ECC after 2030 and disallowing RSA and ECC after 2035. These are proposed dates until the final version is published.

title: FIPS 203, 204 and 205 published
body: NIST published the first post-quantum standards: ML-KEM (FIPS 203), ML-DSA (FIPS 204) and SLH-DSA (FIPS 205).

title: P-256 needs fewer logical qubits than RSA-2048
body: Chevignard, Fouque and Schrottenloher estimate 1,193 logical qubits for the elliptic-curve discrete logarithm on P-256, against 1,409 for RSA-2048 (Gidney 2025). VERA shifts the P-256 horizon earlier accordingly (threat model 2026.09.1).

title: Gidney: RSA-2048 with under a million noisy qubits
body: Craig Gidney estimates RSA-2048 can be factored with under a million noisy qubits (1,409 logical qubits at peak) in under a week. This is the reference row of VERA's quantum-resources table.

title: OpenSSL 3.5 adds ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA
body: OpenSSL 3.5.0 (8 Apr 2025) adds native ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA. VERA uses it to sign its evidence manifest with ML-DSA-65 and to measure PQC latency on the assessment host.
